question.text: Per Chapter 6, the INCENTIVE FEE (carry / performance fee) charged by Cat I/II AIF managers is generally in what range?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Chapter 6, incentive fees are generally between 0% and 20% of the incremental return earned by the AIF, computed per the PPM methodology. The Trap: The 25%-40%-of-NAV option uses the wrong base (NAV rather than incremental return) and an unsupported range. The 2%-5%-of-committed-capital option describes management-fee-style economics, not incentive fee. The 50% flat option overstates well beyond the source-backed range. Note: Other parts of the workbook describe performance-fee ranges with a wider band; the 0%-20% framing here is specifically the Chapter 6 incentive-fee range.
